request.system:
Write the notice employees of Hartwell Germany will
read about this system, from the information pack below.
Use only what the pack says. Plain English, under 300 words,
no headings beyond short labels.

messages.content:
PK-1 What it does: Suggests skills for a person's profile from their own work records; the person accepts or rejects each one.
PK-2 Who it touches: About 9,000 salaried staff in the US, Canada, the UK, the Netherlands, Germany, Australia and Hyderabad.
PK-3 What it reads: Project reports, ticket notes, learning records, project roles.
PK-4 What it never reads: Times, activity data, email, chat, badge and location data, performance ratings.
PK-5 Who uses the output: talent.search, mobility.match, learning.recommend. In Germany no other reader; ka.manager elsewhere; perf.pack nowhere.
PK-6 Where it sits on the Line: F01 automate/draft; F05 automate/retrieve; F02 keep/retrieve (Line v1.2).
PK-7 Human review and appeal: Nothing enters a profile until the person accepts it. Contact: the HR service desk, then the works council or employee panel.
PK-8 Test results by group: Suggestion acceptance by site, age band and sex, 4,000 suggestions, Feb 2028; no group below 0.8 of the highest.
PK-9 What is logged, kept, read: Rejections kept 90 days, then counts only. Group counts kept 84 months. Access log read monthly by the Betriebsrat.
PK-10 How to switch it off: Profile settings, one switch; existing accepted entries stay unless deleted.

content.text:
**Notice to employees of Hartwell Germany: the skills suggestion system**

**What it does**
The system suggests skills for your profile, based on your own work records. You accept or reject each suggestion. Nothing goes into your profile until you accept it.

**What it reads**
Project reports, ticket notes, learning records and project roles.

**What it never reads**
Working times, activity data, email, chat, badge and location data, or performance ratings.

**Who it covers**
About 9,000 salaried staff across the US, Canada, the UK, the Netherlands, Germany, Australia and Hyderabad, including you.

**Who uses the results**
Three tools use the output: talent.search, mobility.match and learning.recommend. In Germany, no one else reads it. Your manager does not receive it here, and it is not used in performance packs.

**Testing**
Hartwell checked 4,000 suggestions in February 2028 and compared how often they were accepted by site, age band and sex. No group fell below 0.8 of the highest group's rate.

**What is kept**
Rejected suggestions are kept for 90 days, then only counts remain. Group counts are kept for 84 months. The Betriebsrat reads the access log every month.

**Questions or concerns**
Contact the HR service desk first. You can also go to the works council.

**Switching it off**
Use the single switch in your profile settings. Entries you have already accepted stay in your profile unless you delete them.
